GA.replaces: prélèvement libératoire sur revenus de capitaux mobiliers
GA.name: IRPP — prélèvement libératoire sur revenus de capitaux mobiliers, dividends (20 %)
GA.doc: art. 109: "L'IRPP pour les bénéficiaires de revenus des capitaux mobiliers est déterminé en appliquant un prélèvement libératoire dont le taux est fixé à 20 % aux revenus tels que définis à l'article 106".
unsupported: 10 % on bonds of at least 5 years issued in Gabon (art. 110 2)

GA.name: IRPP — prélèvement libératoire sur revenus de capitaux mobiliers, interest on claims and deposits (20 %)
GA.doc: art. 106 5°: for the claims, deposits and guarantees of art. 103-104, the gross interest; art. 109: final levy of 20 % on the income defined in art. 106; art. 110 (LF 2021): bank cash bonds 15 %.

GA.name: Taxe spéciale immobilière sur les loyers (15 % of gross rents; nil below 200 000 F a month)
GA.statute: CGI 2025 art. 384-387 (art. 385 as amended by LF 2024)
GA.doc: art. 384: due by persons letting bare land or buildings; art. 385 (LF 2024): owners receiving a monthly rent below 200 000 F are exempt (registered lease and sworn expert report required); art. 386: base = gross rents of all let buildings; art. 387: 15 %. The household's annual rent is taken as twelve equal monthly rents.
unsupported: the exemption's formal conditions (registered lease, expert report) are taken as met

GA.name: Contribution foncière unique, owner's main residence (3 % of rental value less 5 %)
GA.doc: art. 289: base = real rental value at 1 January; art. 292: less 5 % for wear and upkeep (not on bare land); art. 294: 3 % for built property that is the owner's main residence, 15 % in all other cases; base rounded down to the thousand.
unsupported: rounding of the base down to the thousand francs
5-year exemption of new dwellings (Section 2, temporary exemptions)

GA.name: Contribution foncière unique, other built property (15 % of rental value less 5 %)
GA.doc: art. 294: 15 % in all cases other than the owner's main residence.
unsupported: bare land (rental value of land not in the input; rural land on a per-hectare value, art. 294 bis)

GA.name: Prélèvement pour le Fonds national de l'habitat (2 %)
GA.why: 2 % of wages up to the CNSS contribution ceiling (art. 401, 403); the CNSS ceiling is set outside the CGI and is not held
GA.tried: cgi2025.txt Chapitre 8; GA law folder (only CNAMGS pages, ceiling 2 500 000 F for CNAMGS)
